-- Azure SQL Initialization Script — Central Database
-- Purpose  : Create the complete central database schema on a fresh Azure SQL
--            Database instance. Matches the Prisma central schema exactly.
-- Author   : FEV Planning Tool Team
-- Created  : 2026-04-07
-- Modified : 2026-04-07
--
-- Target:
--   Server  : sql-we-genaisys-test.database.windows.net
--   Database: sqldb-we-oua-test-01
--   Schema  : dbo
--
-- Usage:
--   sqlcmd -S sql-we-genaisys-test.database.windows.net -d sqldb-we-oua-test-01 -G \
--          -i backend/prisma/central/init-azure-sql.sql
--
-- Notes:
--   - Idempotent: uses IF NOT EXISTS guards so re-running is safe.
--   - Does NOT seed data. Admin user is created via the seed script.
--   - Schema matches the Prisma model definitions in schema.prisma.
--   - SQL Server self-references use NO ACTION to avoid multiple cascade path
--     errors on Azure SQL Database.
-- =============================================================================

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Table: central_org_units
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'central_org_units' AND schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('dbo'))
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [dbo].[central_org_units] (
        [id]                   NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
        [type]                 NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
        [name]                 NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
        [code]                 NVARCHAR(1000),
        [oe_key]               INT,
        [parent_id]            NVARCHAR(1000),
        [manager_sap_number]   INT,
        [manager_employee_id]  NVARCHAR(1000),
        [active]               BIT NOT NULL,
        [created_at]           DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [central_org_units_created_at_df] DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        [updated_at]           DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT [central_org_units_pkey] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([id]),
        CONSTRAINT [central_org_units_parent_id_fkey] FOREIGN KEY ([parent_id])
            REFERENCES [dbo].[central_org_units]([id]) ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
    );
END;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name = 'central_org_units_parent_id_idx' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.central_org_units'))
BEGIN
    CREATE INDEX [central_org_units_parent_id_idx] ON [dbo].[central_org_units]([parent_id]);
END;
GO
-- copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/central/init-azure-sql.sql lines 80-108
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Table: central_employees
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'central_employees' AND schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('dbo'))
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [dbo].[central_employees] (
        [id]           NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
        [sap_number]   INT NOT NULL,
        [first_name]   NVARCHAR(1000),
        [surname]      NVARCHAR(1000),
        [name]         NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
        [email]        NVARCHAR(1000),
        [org_unit_id]  NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,
        [active]       BIT NOT NULL,
        [created_at]   DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [central_employees_created_at_df] DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        [updated_at]   DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT [central_employees_pkey] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([id]),
        CONSTRAINT [central_employees_sap_number_key] UNIQUE ([sap_number]),
        CONSTRAINT [central_employees_org_unit_id_fkey] FOREIGN KEY ([org_unit_id])
            REFERENCES [dbo].[central_org_units]([id]) ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
    );
END;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name = 'central_employees_org_unit_id_idx' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.central_employees'))
BEGIN
    CREATE INDEX [central_employees_org_unit_id_idx] ON [dbo].[central_employees]([org_unit_id]);
END;
GO
